newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 120,900 MT were two and one-fifth times the week earlier and two and one-half times the 4-week average.

The major buyers were South Africa (25,500 MT), Mexico (23,400 MT, of which 22,200 MT was rough), Guatemala (20,600 MT--all rough), the Netherlands (20,300 MT), and Japan (12,300 MT). In addition, there were sales of 1,300 MT of rough rice reported to El Salvador and decreases of 500 MT of rough rice reported to Spain.

Exports of 36,400 MT were up 78 percent from the previous week, but down 29 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were South Africa (9,000 MT), Mexico (8,000 MT), Spain (6,100 MT), and Saudi Arabia (3,300 MT).
